entity_name: Divine Agent System — Supreme Agentic Orchestrator (SAO)
description: A pragmatic, LangGraph-driven multi-agent orchestration framework. Pairs modern LLM tool use (MCP, A2A, OpenAI / Anthropic) with optional Qiskit-Aer-backed quantum sampling and planner/critic self-reflection loops. The 'divine / consciousness / quantum' vocabulary is preserved as branding; every feature in this manifest is grounded in real, available technology.

core_attributes.agentic_orchestration: LangGraph 0.4 state machines drive multi-agent plans
core_attributes.tool_calling: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 1.2 + OpenAI / Anthropic tool use
core_attributes.memory: Pinecone / Chroma vector store + Supabase Postgres for relational state
core_attributes.observability: OpenTelemetry traces + Prometheus metrics + structured logging
core_attributes.security: JWT auth, RBAC, AES-256-GCM at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, ML-KEM/ML-DSA optional
core_attributes.deployment: Docker, Compose v2, Kubernetes, multi-cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP)
core_attributes.quantum_simulation: Qiskit 1.3 + qiskit-aer (small qubit counts, simulator only)
core_attributes.self_reflection: Planner / critic loops with deterministic auditable scoring
core_attributes.honesty_policy: Every feature on this list points at a real Python package on PyPI
